Probando un gráfico dentro de un post!

```{r}
#| message: false
#| echo: false

library(ggplot2)

theme_set(
  theme_grey(
    base_family = "Atkinson Hyperlegible",
    paper = "#2F2935",
    accent = "#E3467C",
    ink = "#F0BFE7")
)

iris |> 
  ggplot() +
  aes(Petal.Width, Sepal.Width, color = Sepal.Length) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  # usar la paleta "Sunset" para una variable continua
  # colorspace::scale_color_continuous_sequential(palette = "Sunset") +
  scale_color_gradient(low ="#6A3274" , high = "#E3467C") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0, 0.1)))
```
